chapter: Small bands, Harry James and joining Duke Ellington
title: Sonny Greer's original style and personality
summary: Greer sat high, played mostly with his toe and had many instruments around him; Bellson found him funny and wonderful.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: How would you describe his style, his drumming style?

Strictly original. There’s nobody else who was like him. He fit that band. First of all, his stature on the seat. He sat real high. He played with his toe almost all the time. Very seldom with the heel down. He had beaucoup instruments around him. All he had to do was go like this with his right stick and he’d hit something: a set of tympani, chimes, vibes, bells, everything, and he played all of that. He was strictly original.
